comparison.objective: Install a piston through a ring compressor into an engine bore; candidate removes a connector terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual compressor hold-down plus axial piston driving while containing spring rings versus fine latch access and coupled tool-wire extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Piston installed with no ring escape/jam and tools clear; candidate requires selected terminal out without crimp, housing or neighbor damage. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Different assembly direction, scale and force/preload mechanics.
